title: Counting the Coverage Months a Restored Ridgecrest Advantage Enrollment Is Brought Back For
content:
The coverage months restored on a Ridgecrest Advantage Medicare Advantage Health Plan enrollment brought back into cover are counted from how long ago the coverage ended and from the plan premium charges standing on the premium account.

| Where the enrollment and the account stand | The coverage months restored |
| --- | --- |
| The coverage ended at least 1 whole month before the handling date and at least 2 plan premium charges stand on the premium account | The whole months that have passed since the coverage end date, and one more for the month in hand |
| The coverage ended at least 1 whole month before the handling date and fewer than 2 plan premium charges stand on the premium account | The whole months that have passed since the coverage end date |
| The coverage ended less than a whole month before the handling date | 1 |

The first two rows differ only in the one extra coverage month for the month in hand, which is added where at least 2 plan premium charges stand on the premium account and left off where fewer than 2 stand there. The third row is reached on the date alone, whatever stands on the premium account.

### Worked through on hypothetical figures

*A coverage end date of 31 January, a handling date of 12 April, and 3 plan premium charges standing on the premium account.* Two whole months have passed since 31 January, and at least 2 charges stand on the account, so the coverage months restored are 2 with one more for the month in hand, which is 3.

*The same coverage end date and handling date with 1 plan premium charge standing on the premium account.* Two whole months have passed and fewer than 2 charges stand there, so the coverage months restored are 2.

*A coverage end date of 31 March and a handling date of 12 April.* Less than a whole month has passed since the coverage ended, so the coverage months restored are 1.
